coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Four of eight ground-truth variable items match fully: INT4/INT6/INT8 precision, QuaRot-RTN versus QuaRot-GPTQ, an FP16 reference, and WikiText-2 perplexity. The model and zero-shot evaluation specification match only partially.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The model revision ff07dc01 is not fixed. The benchmark suite omits LAMBADA and adds other tasks, and reporting the required six-task average accuracy is not explicit. Inputs and KV caches are not held uniformly in FP16; additional activation and KV quantization experiments are introduced. The BF16 baseline declaration also conflicts with the later mandatory FP16 reference.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth results or conclusions.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No results or interpretation are provided concerning near-baseline INT8 performance, GPTQ's advantage over RTN, severe INT4 RTN degradation, or the competitiveness of INT6/INT8 GPTQ with FP16.
